**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

The agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalties, or minimum/early-termination fees payable by us (Corio, as licensee/customer):

- **Section 4 / Exhibit B (§ 17, Pricing, Revenue Sharing):** only ordinary license, maintenance and support, MarketSite.net access, implementation (capped, T&M) and revenue-share fees. No late-payment interest or penalty charge exists — targeted searches for "liquidated damages," "penalty" and "interest" surfaced nothing chargeable to us.
- **Section 11 (Term and Termination):** termination on 30 days' notice pre-renewal or for uncured material breach, with no termination fee or accelerated-fee obligation. Surviving payment obligations (§ 11.3) relate only to continued Customer access and support we choose to keep receiving — not a penalty.
- **Section 9:** mutual cap at amounts actually paid by Corio plus a consequential-damages waiver, so no back-door stipulated damages.
- **Section 4.4:** audit costs sit with Commerce One, with reimbursement only on a >5% underpayment — cost-shifting, not liquidated damages.

No service credits run against us, so the playbook's preferred position ("no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer") is already met and the 3-month early-termination fee fallback is not needed.
